mapper.insert: INSERT INTO trouble_ticket(name, influence, type, product_line_id, occurrence_time, influence_count, influence_client, during_time, failure_time, influence_scope, reason, restore_time, replay_time, asset_loss, amount_loss, time_line, reason_analysis, trouble_rank, prime_principal, prime_principal_id, minor_principal, minor_principal_id, duty_team, create_man_id, create_man) VALUES (#{name}, #{influence}, #{type}, #{productLineId}, #{occurrenceTime}, #{influenceCount}, #{influenceClient}, #{duringTime}, #{failureTime}, #{influenceScope}, #{reason}, #{restoreTime}, #{replayTime}, #{assetLoss}, #{amountLoss}, #{timeLine}, #{reasonAnalysis}, #{troubleRank}, #{primePrincipal}, #{primePrincipalId}, #{minorPrincipal}, #{minorPrincipalId}, #{dutyTeam}, #{createManId}, #{createMan})
mapper.select: SELECT id, name, influence, type, product_line_id, occurrence_time, influence_count, influence_client, during_time, failure_time, influence_scope, reason, restore_time, replay_time, asset_loss, amount_loss, time_line, reason_analysis, trouble_rank, prime_principal, prime_principal_id, minor_principal, minor_principal_id, duty_team, create_man_id, create_man, create_date, modify_man_id, modify_man, modify_date FROM trouble_ticket WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = false
